items.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024
items.q: I knew how to play with a bass player because I’d been playing with Paul Chambers and Ray Brown and people like that on record.

ctx.x: And they’d make some room for you?

Well what happened was the drummer who had the gig at this particular club that had Sunday afternoon sessions, was a fellow named Dave Berry, who unfortunately has left us, a very sweet man. Hell of a drummer. And it was Dave’s gig and he’d come over to my house a couple of times just to show me some things and then he’d have dinner, and we had a nice relationship. He came over on a break and said, “Eddie, do you want to sit in?” And man I was hoping the floor would open up and I could jump in the hole. Man I…
You had the cream in your band there.
